headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 19, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense with a home run and one RBI. The Cleveland Guardians took down the Milwaukee Brewers 4-2, with Parker Messick earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. The Minnesota Twins dominated the Texas Rangers 9-3, with Trevor Larnach hitting 3 home runs and driving in 3 runs. The Baltimore Orioles fell to the Seattle Mariners in a shutout, 3-0.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. Los Angeles Angels center fielder Mike Trout has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The Chicago White Sox have placed RF Everson Pereira on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. The Kansas City Royals have placed LHP Cole Ragans on the 60-day injured list with left elbow impingement. The Atlanta Braves have transferred RHP Spencer Strider from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. Hunter Stratton has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates from the Atlanta Braves in exchange for catcher Joey Bart. The Seattle Mariners have traded RHP Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash. The Toronto Blue Jays have traded C Tyler Heineman to the Los Angeles Angels for cash. The Kansas City Royals have traded RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Denis Samudio and cash.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Rangers 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-3 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Trevor Larnach leading the offense and Joe Ryan dominating on the mound. Larnach hit 3 home runs, drove in 3 runs, and went 5 for 5 at the plate, while Ryan pitched 5 strong innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Fall to Mariners in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles were defeated 3-0 by the Seattle Mariners in a one-sided matchup. Colt Emerson led the Orioles' offense with a single, two RBIs, and two at-bats.

top_news.title: **Trout Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels center fielder Mike Trout has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The injury occurred on June 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Stratton Heads to Pittsburgh in Trade**
top_news.summary: Hunter Stratton has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates, joining the team after being acquired in a trade. The Atlanta Braves sent Stratton to the Pirates in exchange for catcher Joey Bart.
